finding.claim: Ref count is incremented before calling subscribe, but if subscribe throws or returns a non-function the effect throws before returning cleanup, so the increment is never decremented and future mounts see refCount!=0 and skip subscribing forever.
finding.title: Leaked subscription ref-count on subscribe throw blocks resubscribe

verifier.reason: The code at index.ts:72 increments the count before index.ts:75 calls subscribe and index.ts:77-79 throws for a non-function return, with no try/catch/finally to roll back and no cleanup returned on that path, so the leaked count makes later effects skip the !refCount subscribe branch at index.ts:74.

finding.claim: Disposer function stored in module-level disposers map is invoked on last unsubscribe but never removed from the map, leaving a stale disposed handle stored after cleanup.
finding.title: Disposed subscription handle never cleared from disposers map

verifier.reason: The code stores the disposer at index.ts:81 via disposers.set and invokes it at index.ts:90-92 on last unsubscribe with no disposers.delete anywhere in index.ts, so the disposed handle remains in the map.
